components.name: Busy button
components.purpose: A button for an action that takes time. While its promise is pending it names the act, says aria-busy, keeps focus and takes no second press; it reports the outcome to its parent only once the promise settles.

components.name: Command list
components.purpose: A filter field with a list of results, as a combobox with a listbox popup (WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices combobox pattern). Focus stays in the field; one active option, set by keys and by pointer movement alike, is the one highlighted and the one Enter runs.

components.name: Toast with Undo
components.purpose: A message that an action happened, with Undo, shown for a set time (7 s by default) in a polite status region, above everything in the page an open modal dialog included. A refusal takes its place and stays until dismissed.
